title: G20/G27: retain failing £5-cap contracts and disabled-launch review
public_pr_body:
Finds one brief-to-code mismatch in two places: provided-AI UI/default constant and release 146 company rows default to 1000p (£10), while the requested per-company cap is 500p (£5). Own-key migration 122 already defaults to 500p. Two strict assertions remain failed; no implementation or migration changed, no expected value raised. Rhys/owner must align scope/defaults; no claim that a live company overspent.

Committed test run 241f434f: 10 passed, 2 failed. Passing new checks cover malformed/off switches, both assistant flags, off company features, empty-config Sage/QBO and company-scoped assistant context without money/free text/customer identity. Existing 280-test baseline includes accounting/AI mocks. Preserve original server-only import setup failure and corrected Node-only setup; production guards untouched.

Actual deployment provider connections/flags and full concurrent reservation/key/tenant DB proof remain unverified; Supabase image registry denied. No live provider, production key or AI enablement used. Handover: tests/reviews/b5-g20-g27/B5-G20-G27-REVIEW.md.

- [x] Separate owned reviewer branch; original failures retained; source/lint/type/whitespace checks scoped in report. Raw logs kept byte-for-byte, including original whitespace.
- [ ] Independent owner assessment, actual final-candidate runtime evidence and authorised acceptance remain open.

Explicit Rhys overnight allocation. New b5 test/tool/review files only; no Claude-owned source/test edits, #359 branch modification, ISO pack work, Ready label, main merge, production migrations/wipe/import/counter change, deployment, live AI/automated email or message to John. PRs targeting #359’s branch are review follow-ups only; no merge is requested. Production actions remain subject to Rhys’s separate approval.
